evaluation_scope.preliminary_run_discard_reason: all initial SAGA models reached max_iter without convergence; replacement solver chosen using train-only solver diagnostics

selection.budget_selection_metric: validation F1 at K; ties choose smaller K

full_context_coefficients.interpretation: Coefficients are on standardized log1p numeric and one-hot scales; association is not causation.

investigation_table.prevalence_warning: Risk-ranked capped rows are not a population sample; do not interpret their fraud rate as population prevalence.

limitations: The model and evaluation are for synthetic PaySim data only.
The chronological periods have strongly different row volume and fraud prevalence.
Fraud labels occur only in CASH_OUT and TRANSFER, making transaction type a simulation shortcut in all-population metrics.
Sender pre-balance and balance ratios are available at decision time but may encode PaySim balance-generation artifacts.
Post-event balances and flagged-fraud indicators are excluded from all predictors.
No confidence intervals are reported because transactions are dependent and account-level resampling was not performed.
